searchText: Nethermind also supports Kovan. hey hey, don't know if this is the right place to ask this, I got some questions about eip1559, pls point me to the right place if this is not it is the blocksize limit 30M? i think i'v seen some block bigger then that (might be a mistake) why are some block's gas limit bigger then gas used? <#692078615269212180> is a better place for the second question. The answer to the first is that the block size is set by miners (each block can increase or decrease the limit by a small amount) and right now it is 30M. Rc15 had issues with kovan; stable works. It’s possible etherscan is on an older version. <@!552133098075193354> <@!273808422753796097> I made a draft PR of EIP-4488 (and a bit of additional refactoring+test) in Nethermind here: https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/3649 Unit test are passing but it could use a testnet. Did we have massive reorgs at ropsten about 2 months ago? Amazing, great work! I don't remember the exact date, but yes. IIRC there was at least one 2,000+ block reorg, and several 100+ block reorgs. Ok great thanks, I have a geth node synced to ropsten up to some block (about 2 months ago) which I sometimes launch with `--nodiscover` so that I can query the state and check what it returns. But I noticed that the entire chain which I can still scrape does not match what etherscan reports 🙂 Ya if you want to sync it further, you'll need probabably need to add `--whitelist=10920274=0xfd652086d220d506ae5b7cb80fde97d2f3f7028d346cc7d9d384a83d3d638532` argument since there's a bunch of competing bad chains on ropsten (which IIUC is why Sepolia is the planned Ropsten replacement). Ah yeah its just for development purposes, I want a rather full state trie, but thanks 🙂

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: <#692078615269212180> is a better place for the second question.  The answer to the first is that the block size is set by miners (each block can increase or decrease the limit by a small amount) and right now it is 30M.

excerpts.author: yorickdowne
excerpts.content: Rc15 had issues with kovan; stable works. It’s possible etherscan is on an older version.
